description: Relax search_stress2's domain assertions so modern MiniZinc presolve can narrow domains without triggering model-side assertion failures.
rationale: The model asserts that some intermediate variables have exact domain 0..n. Modern MiniZinc can legitimately narrow those domains during flattening, which preserves semantics but trips the assertion.
semantics_note: This keeps the structural size check and removes only a brittle assertion about exact presolve domains.
